final_explanation: The suspicious “pillow” concealed the severed hand of someone the woman knew. She had assaulted that person and cut off the hand while the victim was alive, then carried it through the baggage checkpoint among her overnight belongings. Security found the hand when they inspected the luggage, exposing the assault, and arrested her.
